items.name: source_links_target_kind_ck
items.purpose: Prevent individual source links targeting relay parents and relay-parent source links targeting individual results.
items.problems: No existing violations of these rules. Relay-leg compatibility representation remains unchanged and is not declared the final normalized model.
items.proposedImprovement: Keep database-level target-kind checks while reviewing broader identity and relay participation relationships separately.
items.verification: 16 isolated PostgreSQL tests; live constraint validated and all 41,214 existing links preserved.
items.rollback: Drop only source_links_target_kind_ck if a demonstrated regression requires rollback; no rows need removal.
